identity.summary: Atmospheric and environmental domain: pressure analogs and ecological substrate signals feeding Drift and Substrate overlays

purpose.role: Atmospheric and environmental domain: pressure analogs and ecological substrate signals feeding Drift and Substrate overlays
purpose.description: Atmosphere provides environmental domain signals — atmospheric pressure analogs, thermal gradients, ecological substrate stress indicators, and seasonal cycle markers — that feed directly into the Drift Overlay (as environmental envelope signals) and the Substrate Overlay (as baseline basin pressure readings). In atmospheric and ecological diagnostics, Atmosphere serves as the primary domain module. In cross-domain runs, it provides environmental context that modulates drift velocity thresholds and substrate depletion rates.
